kind: production measurement: txid display recent-worker block-to-serving before and after a source and unit-limit change
deployment: production recent-01 only: transparent-txid-display-worker.service drop-in zz-latency.conf; controller, archive worker, router and history unchanged

source.after: 07f906753cb0 (main); binary built from aede3e26 plus the same runtime.rs change, the only intervening main commit 8cccfa44 being docs-only

binary.name: transparent-txid-server
binary.build: cargo build --locked --release -p transparent-shard-server --bin transparent-txid-server; RUSTFLAGS=-C target-cpu=x86-64-v3 -C target-feature=+pclmulqdq; on roman-dev-2; not the CI release artifact

hosts.recent-01: DigitalOcean DO-Regular 2.0 GHz, 4 vCPU (AVX2), 7.8 GiB, Linux 6.8.0-124-generic; shares CPU with the history transparent-shard-server (weight 100, nice 0, no quota)
hosts.roman-dev-2: DO-Premium-Intel 8 vCPU, shared development host; stage probe and builds only

publication.recent_records: about 47,300 at the start of the window

inputs.raw/cycles.jsonl.gz: controller timeline 'cycle' events activated from 24 h before the deploy start, as recorded (gzip -9n)
inputs.raw/history-prewarm.txt: history worker 'prewarm finished' seconds on recent-01 from journalctl, ISO time and seconds
inputs.raw/cpu-before.txt: 1 Hz cgroup usage_usec samples (unix time, display, history) on recent-01 before the deploy, about 6 min
inputs.raw/cpu-after.txt: same, about 10 min after the deploy
inputs.raw/probe-stages.txt: per-stage build timings of one txid-2k table on roman-dev-2 at 1 and 2 build threads

harness.probe: harness/probe_display_build_stages.rs.txt, an ignored test appended to the runtime.rs test module; not committed as source

definitions.freshness_ms: per block: controller activation time minus the time the controller first saw that height on its node (controller.rs)
definitions.prepare_ms: controller-observed duration of the recent worker's prepare call
definitions.ship_ms: copy of the candidate to recent-01

limitations: 40 post-deploy cycles is not the 300-block live criterion
history prewarm comparison over 40 rebuilds; +3% p50 is within the range of noise but not shown to be noise
the 20 QPS measurement started 13:53 UTC may overlap both windows
acceptance: not an acceptance result; the live criteria remain open
